messages:
Lee: heads-up: since 08:02 UTC I'm seeing a sustained drift of traffic from eu-west-1 to eu-central-1 for tenant=zephyr-labs (tier=platinum)
Lee: routing logs show a flurry of fallbacks after short-lived affinity blips
Lee: sample decision log:
```
route_eval: tenant=zephyr-labs tier=platinum src_az=eu-west-1b az_affinity=0.62 fallback=variant:eu-central-1a reason=affinity_breach concurrent_remote=0.12
```
devon-bot: alert: routing-fallback-spike (id: rfs-2026-03-20-0824) triggered for router=smart-router-03
Ana: why are we sending that much cross-region? quota and egress cost for that tenant is non-trivial
Devon: looked into traces, appears KV cache warmup + a small metric gap in affinity scorer for eu-west-1b. affinity window length is 6s which might be too short for noisy loads
Priya: ah — we set affinity_window=6s in the tenant override to reduce stuck pins, but that makes us hypersensitive to momentary misses
Michael: current tenant policy (redacted):
```
{"affinity_window_s":"6","affinity_threshold":0.7,"max_remote_fraction":0.2,"fallback_strategy":"nearest-variant"}
```
Lee: note the max_remote_fraction=0.2 is high for platinum; combined with short window it allowed many concurrent fallbacks
Priya: mitigation options: increase affinity_window to 30s; lower max_remote_fraction to 0.05; add a per-AZ soft circuit-breaker that triggers when remote_p95 > 150ms
Devon: agree. Also add hysteresis: once circuit trips keep reduced remote_fraction for 2 minutes to avoid flip-flop
Ana: telemetry ask: add metric fallback_spread (unique remote AZs per minute) and tag fallback_reason, affinity_epoch. Helps detect cascades vs steady-state routing
Michael: can we hot-patch the tenant policy for a canary cohort? prefer incremental: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%
Lee: runtime policy API supports staged rollouts. I can push a 1% canary now with new settings (affinity_window=30s, max_remote_fraction=0.05)
devon-bot: deploy: runtime-policy-update job started job_id=rpu-45321 target=zephyr-labs canary=1%
Devon: console UX: the rollout UI should surface interaction effects (window x threshold x max_remote) and warn if settings amplify oscillations. Today it only shows single knobs which is misleading
ConsoleProduct: noted. I'll file UX ticket to add an "interaction preview" and a small simulation graph in the rollout modal
Priya: operational quickfix: add global safety rule: if concurrent_fallbacks > 4% of tenant requests for >90s then cap all that tenant's remote_fraction to 0.03 and raise affinity_threshold by +0.08
Ana: sounds good. Also limit cross-region egress by quota so billing team gets notified when fallback-mediated egress exceeds expected
Lee: canary at 1% live at 08:28 UTC. initial telemetry: canary fallback_rate down 5x, remote_p95 ~ 70ms
Michael: promoting to 10% at 08:34 UTC, monitoring graphs now
Devon: I'll add fallback_reason and affinity_epoch to router traces and emit fallback_spread metric. PR in a few mins
devon-bot: update: runtime-policy-update job rpu-45321 completed (canary=1%)
Priya: leaving thread for now; will put circuit-breaker patch in staging then prod if canary stays green
Lee: tl;dr action list: (1) Lee apply staged policy -> done (2) Devon add trace labels + metric (3) Priya push circuit-breaker/hysteresis rule (4) ConsoleProduct create UX ticket for interaction preview (5) Ana add billing alert for cross-region egress
Michael: thanks all. keep posting p95/p99 and concurrent_fallbacks. I'll create a temporary dashboard panel for zephyr-labs fallback_spread & egress-cost
Lee: closing for now, will reopen if spike returns :white_check_mark:
